description: Save the user's plan for a day; the Fluent app shows it on its home screen. To change an existing plan, call get_my_day first and pass its plan version as expectedVersion: without expectedVersion this only creates, and a stale version is refused with the current plan so you can merge. 1-20 items. The whole plan must be under 8 KB (larger is rejected with 422). Use kind "thinking" for what the user is mulling over (an open question or a decision to make). Dates from yesterday to a week ahead.

client.description: Optional: your name, shown as the plan's author (e.g. "Claude")

date.description: Optional: the user's local date, YYYY-MM-DD. Leave it out for the user's today in their Fluent time zone; the result names the date and zone used.

expectedVersion.description: The version of the plan you are replacing (from get_my_day). Omit to create.

personId.description: Optional: the Fluent person this item involves

taskId.description: Optional: the Fluent task this item works on

time.description: Optional start time, HH:MM (24-hour, the user's local time)

title.description: What to do, at most 120 characters

summary.description: Optional one-line summary of the day, at most 280 characters

name: set_day_plan
